explain_task.question: In the revised model, explain why the objective increases by exactly 4400 relative to the original, even though all premium-animal variables (`cows_premium`, `sheep_premium`, `chickens_premium`) stay at 0. Your answer must trace the business phrase “gate”/“expanded setup” to the binary `z_expand`, identify which revised code lines/constraints let `cows_regular` rise from 70 to 86, and name the exact CSV field names and parameter values that make constraint `_C5` binding with dual value 40 while `_C4` remains slack. Also interpret the solver-state meaning of `_C5`’s shadow price and explain why that marginal value cannot be linearly extrapolated indefinitely once the gate variable and other constraints are considered.
